evidence_items.explanation: The construction shortfall makes delivery schedules questionable. It does not establish whether unrealistic construction assumptions, unavailable power, or another constraint caused the lack of progress.
Long connection timelines provide a material competing explanation. The report does not show whether developers kept building while awaiting power or postponed construction because of it.

unresolved_gaps: No representative inventory of physically complete facilities awaiting power was established.
No matched project records separate original schedule infeasibility from subsequent power-related delays.
The evidence does not test whether developers defer construction when power delivery is uncertain.
A missed schedule does not by itself prove that the original schedule was unreasonable.
